title: Planet Tweaks V3.5.0 - Zenn Mantle Restored, Instant Build Fix & Live Macro Sandbox
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.5.0 (2026-11-18): (1) Instant Build Stability Fix: Moved Instant Build off the synchronous low-level keyboard hook thread, fixed Win32 KEYEVENTF_SCANCODE wVk=0 injection, added Win/Alt modifier guard, and added automatic stale-key pruning + 100ms physical-release watchdog so keys/clicks never stick or scramble input. (2) Live Macro Test Sandbox Fix: Macros now run natively inside the Macro Test Sandbox with right-click menu suppression and a live physical/simulated key & mouse signal feed. (3) Zenn Mantle & Fall Cancel (Legacy v3.2.7 Engine): Holds Spacebar at 0ms + holds Place Build continuously (zero W/A/S/D keys) while spamming your two bound Build Keys at your configured delays (8ms default). (4) Workspace Cleanup: Quarantined/removed Elevator 90s and removed the Diagnostics sidebar tab while keeping Spec Switcher restored.
